period_note: HALF-YEARLY filing (occupies the Q2 slot per project convention). Balance sheet is the 30-Jun-2026 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis. Income statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (H1 = 6 months), matching this bank's established Q2/Half-Yearly convention (see 2025_Q2.json). Source PDF is a 19-page scan (pdftotext extracted 0 lines); this bank's own Half-Yearly filing presents Consolidated statements first (pages 3-6) then a separate Solo ('ONE Bank PLC', no subsidiary wording) set (pages 7-9) -- the Solo set was used. Figures were read directly off the rendered page images (pdftoppm 200dpi), not tesseract OCR'd -- text was clean and legible. Cross-checked against this filing's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column, which matches this dataset's existing 2025_Q4.json exactly for total_assets (360,112.870901m), total_liabilities (336,745.540023m), total_equity (23,367.330879m), paid_up_capital (10,658.21887m) and off_balance_sheet_exposures (63,801.435009m). Balance-sheet identity holds within BDT 1,000 of rounding (356,519.01206 + 23,768.274038 = 380,287.286098 vs reported total_assets 380,287.286099). Income statement fully reconciles: operating_profit = total_operating_income - total_operating_expenses (5,330.16861-3,658.12509=1,672.04352 exact); profit_before_tax = operating_profit - total_provision (1,672.04352-861.546498=810.497022, matches reported 810.497023 within BDT 1,000 rounding); profit_after_tax = profit_before_tax - tax_expense (810.497023-144.718314=665.778709, matches reported 665.778708 within BDT 1,000 rounding); tax_expense = current_tax + deferred_tax (168.050749+(-23.332435)=144.718314 exact). eps_cumulative (0.62) is independently corroborated: profit_after_tax_cumulative (665.778708m) / 1,065.821887m weighted-average shares = 0.6247, rounds to the reported 0.62. This filing ALSO discloses a discrete Apr-Jun 2026 column as a bonus (not part of line_items, used only for cross-validation): discrete Q2 PAT (337.647529m) + Q1's cumulative PAT from 2026_Q1.json (328.131179m) = 665.778708m, matching this filing's own H1-cumulative PAT exactly -- confirms both quarters were read correctly, and discrete Q2 EPS (0.32) + Q1 EPS (0.31) = 0.63, close to but not exactly the reported H1-cumulative EPS of 0.62 (small non-additivity from the EPS rounding convention, not a data error). No classified-loan/NPL breakdown is disclosed anywhere in this filing -- only available annually; npl_pct is intentionally omitted here, consistent with this bank's other interim quarters in this dataset.
